about: L7-WP01 characterization suites for lane L7 (Networking), planset v060 lanes/L7_NETWORKING.md section 4, L7-WP01. Each suite pins today's networking behavior before an L7 work package changes the code around it. A later L7 PR that changes a pinned behavior names the suite and test it supersedes and replaces the assertion only with a stricter one, in a commit that says why. LQ is to run every suite here on every merge-queue group; until then the suites run in the ordinary cargo and vitest jobs. char_suite_is_listed_for_lq fails when this file and the L7-CH-1 suite file stop naming the same tests.

suites.pins: with no CITRATE_CLUSTER_LISTEN the mesh is off and the operator env always wins; the default listen is all interfaces on 4211; the pairing listener binds every interface on an OS-picked port; the pairing key is new every run and a new issuer forgets used and outstanding tokens; pairing hints refuse public, loopback and cloud metadata addresses; the Tailscale CLI is only asked `status --json`; mesh-only actions answer the same MESH_NOT_AVAILABLE words in core and in the Add-a-machine sheet

the mesh policy and its sign-off gate (existing tests, kept): TRANSPORT_SIGNED_OFF may be true only with a verifying CL-S4 record, the default needs both preconditions and respects the member's off switch, the member is told why in plain words, and the multi-group flag matches the bundled daemon rev
the member's mesh switch model for no status, an unsigned build, an operator setting and a signed build
